At 30 Jun 2026 it is 1.24x (48,776 + 9,711 = 58,487 over 47,336). DEBT BASIS (both readings shown in ch.3): A) gross incl. leases 1.29x Mar-26 / 1.24x Jun-26 = FAIL; B) gross excl. leases 1.07x / 1.03x = passes red line, fails <0.70 compounder test; C) company's net debt (borrowings less cash, bank deposits and investments) 0.49x / 0.42x = passes both; D) net of free liquid funds (cash and investments less Rs 10,007.32 Mn pledged and Rs 239.10 Mn restricted deposits), incl. leases 0.96x at Mar-26; E) parent-only (standalone) 0.76x. Reading A DECIDES because: the scoring.json IN rule has a single carve-out (trade LC acceptances where interest cover >= 3.0x) and names no cash or lease netting; the US red line in the same file uses Net Debt/EBITDA, so gross was chosen for India; Rs 10,007 Mn of deposits is pledged against borrowings (not free cash); the company's own audited ratio is gross incl. leases (1.29; FY25 0.67 reproduces the same way); parent-only 0.76x excludes the UK (GBP 150 Mn = Rs 18,643.92 Mn) and Cayman (Rs 11,086 Mn) debt, 61% of borrowings, whose equity (incl. Rs 24,236 Mn goodwill and intangibles, 53% of equity) is in the consolidated base. Tangible-equity gross ratio would be 2.77x. The margin is thin (0.04 to 0.09x) and may flip at the 30 Sep 2026 balance sheet due 30 Oct 2026 (our estimate 1.18 to 1.25x, central 1.20x). Other red lines: interest cover PASS (4.97x FY26 audited; 4.00x Q1 FY27 own arithmetic; ICRA 7.3x 9M FY26); promoter pledge PASS (0.0% every quarter Dec 2023-Sep 2026; promoters 63.27%); 3Y cumulative CFO/PAT PASS (3,674/2,387 = 1.54, FY24-FY26). STAGE 4 SELECTOR: the ledger label 'Stage 4 (Markdown)' comes from a code rule (close < SMA50 < SMA200 and SMA50 below its value 10 sessions ago) that does not test the 200-day slope. scoring.json requires Close < FALLING SMA50 < FALLING SMA200 with Test C failing. SMA50 is falling (1,917.09 21 sessions ago to 1,820.25); SMA200 is 1,843.15 vs 1,842.10 63 sessions ago (+0.06%), i.e. NOT falling (momentum-gate A2 passes on the 63-day window); Test C fails (C2: close 1,646.90 < SMA20 1,739.29 and 28d RS -10.02%; C4: RSI 31.42 < 32.0). The deciding test is therefore the SMA200 slope: the Stage 4 red line is NOT triggered on the exact wording (near-miss; likely to trigger if price stays near 1,650). Momentum gate NO_MOMENTUM (A1, A3, B1, B2, C2, C4 fail). Archetype: COMPOUNDER standards fail on D/E < 0.70 (gross); ROCE 16% FY26 (15.5% TTM) is only just above 15% and falling (32/26/21/16 FY23-FY26); TURNAROUND test (3) fails: reverse DCF implied 10Y growth 16.17% (own check 16.19%) vs realistic ~12-15%, P/E 39.0 vs 3Y median 41.3 (5.6% below). Asymmetry would clear floors (3.56:1 at CMP; 3.38:1 at zone high) but is moot after the red-line failure. Layer 2 and Layer 3 are completed in full.

archive.investment_thesis: Narayana is a cardiac-led hospital group whose Indian hospitals improved margins from 20.6% to 24.8% without adding beds (ARPOB +9%), with 1.54x three-year cash conversion and zero promoter pledge. The 2025-26 UK purchase (Rs 22,010 Mn, 95% NHS revenue), Cayman and Indian insurance losses and a late bed pipeline raised gross debt-to-equity to 1.29x, cut ROCE to 16% and left profit flat at about Rs 800 crore for three years. The stock (39x trailing, 5.6% under its 3Y median 41.3x) is in a downtrend with falling estimates.
